notes: Soppelsa 2018 tests 10 biostimulant products on organic apple in Italy. Li 2022 selected 7 of these as GT rows (pairs 1102-1108) corresponding to HFA, PHs(x2), SWE(x2), Chi, Si categories. The GT ctrl_mean of 4.87 kg/tree differs from the JSON ctrl of 14.61 kg/tree — likely a 3-year average vs single-year value, or different units/data subset. Regardless, effect percentages match almost perfectly (within 0.02%) for all 6 matched pairs, confirming the Yield (kg tree-1) JSON obs are the correct matches. CHI (Chitosan, pair 1107) yield was not extracted by our AI, creating one unmatched GT row. The remaining 79 unmatched JSON obs are non-yield outcomes (leaf area, fruit quality metrics, phytochemicals) and three yield arms not selected by Li 2022 (PHE, ZIN, VIT).
